title: High Churn, High Monthly Charges
description: This cluster represents customers who are likely to churn, indicated by a strong positive deviation in 'Churn Label_Yes' and negative in 'Churn Label_No'. They also tend to have significantly higher monthly and total charges compared to the global average. The missing 'Churn Reason' is a notable characteristic for this group.

title: High Churn Risk, Fiber Optics
description: This cluster represents customers with a very high propensity to churn, indicated by 'Churn Label_Yes' and 'Churn Value' deviations. These customers are significantly more likely to have fiber optic internet service, month-to-month contracts, and lack online security or tech support. They also tend to have higher monthly charges, suggesting price sensitivity or dissatisfaction with service levels contributing to churn.

title: No Internet Service, Lower Charges
description: This cluster predominantly consists of customers with no internet service. They also tend to have lower monthly charges. This group shows a strong absence of internet-related security and support services.

title: DSL Internet, No Phone Service
description: This cluster is characterized by a strong preference for DSL internet service. Customers in this group overwhelmingly do not have phone service. They also tend to have fewer additional phone line options. Monthly charges are notably lower than average.
